smt-2023-general-tiebreaker-01.title: Expected value
smt-2023-general-tiebreaker-01.body:
Assume the dart lands uniformly on the board of area $36\pi$. The regions have areas $4\pi$, $12\pi$, $20\pi$, so probabilities $\frac19,\frac13,\frac59$.

Expected winnings: $4\cdot\frac19-2\cdot\frac13+1\cdot\frac59=\frac{4-6+5}{9}=\frac13$. A fair game costs $\frac13$ dollar.

**Answer: $\frac13$ dollar**

smt-2023-general-tiebreaker-02.title: Use the circumcenter
smt-2023-general-tiebreaker-02.body:
The two common points lie on the line through the circumcenter $O$ of $\triangle ABC$ perpendicular to its plane, symmetric about the plane, each at height $\sqrt3$ above it. A common point is at distance $6$ from each center, so the circumradius is $OA=\sqrt{36-3}=\sqrt{33}$.

For an equilateral triangle the circumradius is $\frac{s}{\sqrt3}$, so $s=\sqrt3\cdot\sqrt{33}=\sqrt{99}=3\sqrt{11}$.

**Answer: $3\sqrt{11}$**
